Summary.Name: DeepCORO-MACE
Summary.Description: DeepCORO-CLIP based research model that produces nine one-year cardiovascular outcome scores from up to three coronary angiography videos.

Mechanism.Outcome: One-year composite MACE and component outcome scores
Mechanism.Output: Sigmoid scores for composite MACE, urgent revascularization, non-fatal myocardial infarction, complete coronary occlusion, cardiovascular death, non-fatal stroke, heart-failure hospitalization, life-threatening arrhythmia, and cardiogenic shock
Mechanism.Target_population: Adults undergoing coronary angiography represented by the model development cohort
Mechanism.Input_data_source: Coronary angiography study, up to three videos ordered by DICOM SeriesTime
Mechanism.Model_type: Deep Learning (MViT video encoder plus multiple-instance linear probing)

Uses_and_directions.General_use: Research and demonstration of angiography-derived one-year outcome scores.
Uses_and_directions.Directions: Submit one complete diagnostic XA study. Interpret every value as a model score, not a calibrated clinical probability.
Uses_and_directions.Not_intended_use: Diagnosis, autonomous risk stratification, or changing monitoring, treatment, revascularization, or discharge decisions.

Warnings_and_limitations.Research_only: No regulatory clearance. The model and the 0.5 display thresholds are not validated for clinical decision-making.
Warnings_and_limitations.Calibration: Displayed sigmoid values are not established as calibrated absolute risks. A score above 0.5 is only an uncalibrated research flag.
Warnings_and_limitations.Primary_outputs: Composite MACE, urgent revascularization, non-fatal myocardial infarction, and complete coronary occlusion are emphasized in the report.
Warnings_and_limitations.Low_event_outputs: Cardiovascular death had only four events in the held-out cohort and is not reliable as a standalone estimate. Non-fatal stroke, heart-failure hospitalization, life-threatening arrhythmia, and cardiogenic shock are exploratory low-event outputs.
Warnings_and_limitations.Clinical_context: Angiography alone does not capture all clinical determinants of cardiovascular outcomes. Use validated clinical assessment and clinician review.
Warnings_and_limitations.Input_selection: The service uses at most the first three processable videos after ordering by DICOM SeriesTime; additional videos are ignored and missing slots are masked.

Artifact_provenance.Checkpoint_heads: Nine binary heads under the linear_probing state-dict key

Résumé.Description: Modèle de recherche fondé sur DeepCORO-CLIP qui produit neuf scores d'événements cardiovasculaires à un an à partir d'au plus trois vidéos de coronarographie.

Avertissements.Recherche_uniquement: Aucune autorisation réglementaire. Le modèle et les seuils d'affichage de 0,5 ne sont pas validés pour la prise de décision clinique.
Avertissements.Interprétation: Les valeurs sigmoid affichées ne sont pas des risques absolus étalonnés. Elles ne doivent pas modifier la surveillance, le traitement, la revascularisation ou le congé.
Avertissements.Sorties_exploratoires: Le décès cardiovasculaire ne comptait que quatre événements dans la cohorte de test. Cette sortie et les autres composantes à faible nombre d'événements doivent être considérées comme exploratoires.
